node.title: XR SL-2-RES maximal selected window-divisor count: exact-depth residual <=17n^2/25
node.statement: At each prize row and high band-proper depth, let R_d(u,v) contain the degree-(n-k-d) monic split squarefree divisors E_T|X^n-1 satisfying both top-d window systems, whose reconstructed codeword pair has full joint core exactly H\T, has L_P>=2 under support-wise first-match selection, and survives the generic strip order. Then 25|R_d|<=17n^2. The exact remaining alternatives are the full-joint-rank split-divisor target and the deficient-rank target where at least 2(h-d) evaluation roots are forced on the entire left syzygy kernel; every other deficient system is proved to have N_d<=n. Raw affine divisors without maximality/selection remain outside the assertion.
